lessons_used: Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results across most tests.

Evidence is still thin for adoption copy, choose_path layout, finish copy, finish new_screen, finish notification, home new_flow, sign_in copy, sign_in hint, sign_in incentive, and sign_in layout because each has only 1 test.

Adoption redesign (3 tests), choose_path copy (3 tests), adoption hint (2 tests), sign_in notification (2 tests), and sign_in reorder (2 tests) hurt performance or showed no clear effect.
